title: Do not worry, it will be a purification
arabic: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
transliteration: Lā ba'sa ṭahūrun in shā Allāh.
translation: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.
notes: Said to a sick person to comfort and encourage them.

title: I ask Almighty Allah to make you well
arabic: أَسْـأَلُ اللهَ العَـظيـم، رَبَّ العَـرْشِ العَـظيـم أَنْ يَشْفـيك . (سبع مرات)
translation: I ask Almighty Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to make you well.
reference: At-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/210 and Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/180
notes: Recite seven times in Arabic. A powerful dua for healing the sick.
